info.title: OctoEvidence.Cli
info.description: Agent-owned OKF v0.2 component knowledge: discover, prepare, validate, cite, route, and reconcile bundles through CLI and MCP.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Agent-owned OKF v0.2 component knowledge: prepare, validate, cite, route, and reconcile through Git.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: init
commands.description: Declare components, agree the sync branch, and tell the agent how to write their bundles.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --declare
options.description: Directories to declare as components, relative to the repository root.

options.name: --sync-branch
options.description: Branch every agent compares against. Detected from the remote when omitted, and written to octoevidence.json so the whole team shares it.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check that components are declared, described, reviewed, and in step with the branch.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: component
commands.description: Inventory, prepare, validate, cite, route, and reconcile agent-owned OKF bundles.

commands.name: list
commands.description: Show declared components and what each one knows.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: cite
commands.description: Resolve a line range into the digest a claim needs, and print the lines it covers.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --lines
options.description: Line range, as 42 or 42-60. Omit to cite the whole file.

arguments.name: COMPONENT
arguments.description: Component directory, relative to the repository root.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: File to cite, relative to the component.

commands.name: find
commands.description: Rank components by how likely they are to matter for a request.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Compare component knowledge against the branch that is the source of truth.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --branch
options.description: Branch to compare against. Overrides syncBranch in octoevidence.json.

options.name: --fetch-every
options.description: Seconds between fetches. 0 fetches every time; -1 never fetches.

options.name: --fail-on-drift
options.description: Exit non-zero when a component changed on the branch. For hooks and CI. [default: False]

commands.name: pull
commands.description: Materialize the source branch's OKF bundles for remote-only and remote-ahead components. Never merges: diverged bundles are refused, local bundles are never touched.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --branch
options.description: Branch to pull from. Overrides syncBranch in octoevidence.json.

arguments.name: COMPONENT
arguments.description: One component path; omit to pull every pullable component.

commands.name: prepare
commands.description: Prepare an agent to fill every declared OKF bundle or one component.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --prompt
options.description: The user's goal, used to focus what the agent should document.

arguments.name: SCOPE
arguments.description: all, or a component path. Defaults to all.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate OKF v0.2 and the no-code profile.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --fail-on-error
options.description: Exit non-zero when any bundle violates OKF or the no-code policy. [default: False]

arguments.name: COMPONENT
arguments.description: One component path; omit to validate all declarations.

commands.name: okf
commands.description: The Open Knowledge Format bundles components are described in.

commands.name: guide
commands.description: How to write an OKF v0.2 bundle: layout, frontmatter, conventions, and a worked example.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit as JSON instead of markdown. [default: False]

arguments.name: SECTION
arguments.description: One of: layout, frontmatter, provenance, trust, index-log, attestation, claims, database, no-code, procedure. Omit for all of it.

commands.name: hook
commands.description: Deterministic lifecycle checks for agent hook configurations. `init` wires these automatically.

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Session-close check: exits 2 with feedback while OKF validation fails, 1 on unreconciled drift.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root; defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Run the agent-owned OKF v0.2 MCP server over standard input/output. No model calls.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Repository root. Defaults to the project the agent is working in.

options.name: --branch
options.description: Branch treated as the source of truth. Overrides syncBranch in octoevidence.json.

options.name: --fetch-every
options.description: Seconds between fetches. The comparison itself is always local and instant.
